lines.text: In Nagaland, central money for the rural jobs scheme must be passed on within three days.
The audit found one thousand seven hundred and ten crore rupees released late. Anywhere from four days, to two hundred and thirty-eight.
Late releases carry interest at twelve per cent. The audit puts that bill at twenty-two point three seven crore rupees.
Then the State's own share. It owed three hundred and thirty-eight crore rupees. It released two hundred and thirty-four.
A hundred and four crore rupees short.
The State government replied in December twenty twenty-four. It noted the findings, and said they would be pursued.
